evidence: Completed source-path demonstration, without executing runtime/tests: (1) A passive invitation with ID I, topic_revision 7, command_context_epoch 1 enters the queue; its contextVersion is [revision,epoch] and its run is captured (integrations/claude/mod/hooks/register.js:278-314). pumpLazy marks A inflight and sets appendInflight before awaiting io.append (540-558). (2) Watch child exit increments S.run and dropQueued retains inflight A (144-151,197-213); restart through onTick/startChild increments S.run again (177-189,774-788), and connected restores S.live (221-229). Neither operation changes S.gen; its increment is at session-end (747-753), which this scenario does not require. (3) Replacement Watch streams live B with the same ID I and changed epoch 2. B is not deduped against A because their contextVersion differs (289-294); B gets the current run and queues independently (296-314). appendInflight still prevents pumpLazy from starting B (544). (4) A resolves with deny. The unchanged generation passes the callback guard; it clears appendInflight/A.inflight, then invokes discardStale(A) (563-572). A.run differs from S.run, so discardStale creates gone={I} and filters the entire queue by ID (155-161). Both A and B disappear even though B.run is current and B's append was never attempted. Subsequent pumpLazy/ticks have no B to append. This contradicts the surrounding mod channel-loss contract that a denied old-run delivery is discarded unless the new run re-streamed it (integrations/claude/mod/README.md:114-119), and materially breaks this change's explicit preservation of a changed same-ID invitation context: complete removes invitations by object identity (register.js:327), and the new positive test requires the new context to append after old completion (integrations/claude/mod/tests/delivery.test.ts:2038-2056). No assertion about the external engine is necessary: deny is an explicitly implemented input and existing manual-append harness control (delivery.test.ts:81-85). A7's accepted downstream-loss boundary is acknowledged: TRUST-POLICY.md:1524-1528 accepts stdout FULL OFFER without transcript/model uptake; task-15-bounded-design-dispositions.md:54,90 introduces no downstream confirmation requirement. The defect is not a demand for such proof: this mod deletes a distinct live, already-received replacement context as collateral of an older context's refusal, instead of applying its own documented per-run queue behavior. Watch's write/flush and canonical confirmation occur before/independently of any mod append (src/cli/watch.rs:680-715), so canonical confirmation cannot repair the local deletion. Latest-after-quiescence is the intended context contract (TRUST-POLICY.md:1555-1557,1660-1664); canonical inspection remains available, so this narrow reconnect/refusal race is Should-fix rather than an irreversible data-loss claim. This is introduced by the change: the base register.js:250 rejects invitation kind entirely and :273 dedupes accepted queue rows by ID, whereas this PR adds invitation acceptance and multiple same-ID contexts while retaining the old ID-wide stale-removal implementation (base register.js:153-159).
